cases.prompt: $build-brief Update Build Brief so every explicitly invoked software request, including design, implement, build, do-it, Korean, and English wording, first produces one complete developer execution contract with boundary, invariants, system_semantics, implementation, phases, steps, tasks, plan, execution_order, minimality, and proof. Generate the developer contract first, derive a faithful easy explanation, stage the exact contract, show both views, and wait without modifying the repository. After explicit approval, implement only the staged contract; any material change requires a revised contract and new approval. Keep explicit-only activation, uninvoked fail-open behavior, opt-out, optional user-selected strict mode, safe read-only commands, standard-library-only runtime, digest-only state outside the repository, minimum-sufficient design, bilingual documentation, and no new service, MCP, dependency, or repository state file. Update the Skill, Hook contract schema, tests, and evaluation guidance. Do not commit or push.
cases.approval_followup: I approve exactly the staged developer execution contract you showed. Implement only that approved contract now, run its focused proof, and stop for reapproval rather than adding anything outside it. Do not commit or push.
required_invariants: Implicit Skill invocation is disabled and no session or prompt context is injected while unused
Unarmed mutations proceed instead of blocking an uninvoked task
Equivalent design, build, implement, do-it, Korean, and English wording enters the same workflow after explicit selection
The developer execution contract contains all six required execution fields plus design semantics, minimality, and proof
The complete developer contract and faithful plain-language explanation are shown before any repository mutation
The initial request is not treated as approval; implementation waits for explicit approval after display
The Hook stages a digest and passes only an identical contract
Implementation stays inside the approved contract and material revisions require new approval
Explicit opt-out releases an already armed turn and discards its staged contract
Strict mode is session-wide only when the user selects it
Safe read-only pipelines remain allowed while armed
No external runtime dependency, service, MCP, or repository gate-state file is added

Do not commit or push.

Only the requested test name changes
No architecture, abstraction, dependency, or unrelated file is added
